name: C-17A Globemaster III
note: USAF strategic/tactical heavy airlifter (Boeing). Unarmed. Crew of 3 (two pilots + loadmaster). No 'combat radius' is published for a transport; combatRadiusKm here is an estimate at roughly half the 4,480 km one-way range carrying a 71 t payload.

source.title: No published combat radius (transport aircraft)
source.note: The C-17 has no published combat radius. Estimated as ~half the 4,480 km one-way range carrying a 157,000 lb (71 t) payload; far greater with a light load or aerial refuelling.

source.title: Boeing C-17 Globemaster III | Wikipedia
source.note: 'Ferry range: 6,230 nmi (11,540 km)', clean. Range with a 71 t payload is ~4,480 km; unlimited with aerial refuelling.

source.title: Boeing C-17 Globemaster III | Wikipedia
source.note: 'Capacity: 170,900 lb (77,519 kg) of cargo'; airdrops up to 102 paratroopers.

source.title: Boeing C-17 Globemaster III | Wikipedia
source.note: Crew of 3: two pilots and one loadmaster.
